notes.title: Update 22, Tooth For Jaw
notes.content:
New enemy:
Oar Eel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/19cae53a60d24ae089c65f0f1dc9bcbed5bc1df3.png
Spawns on the Crystal Trench.
A neutral, high health giant.
When threatened, lunges at the attacker and causes a low-damage electric discharge that applies Thunderstruck.
Takes a long time to recharge between attacks.


New items:
Retalieel
Dropped by Oar Eels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/d9f3e99cbc7e45eaddaccdd13980850b2a7190c4.png
Spell cooldown: 2.
Summon an eel that orbits around you.
On getting hit: An eel will chase the agressor and discharge electricity, dealing damage and applying Thunderstruck in a large area.
You can only have up to 4 eels at the same time.

Cactus Buddy
Recipe: Cactus Bud + Retalieel.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/d80188ce9c022a9c896b7ec0f9b1b1b6ce8f93ff.png
Spell cooldown: 6.
Summon a cactus buddy that floats above you for 10 seconds.
On getting hit: Cactus shoots 4 rings of 8 spines around you, and a burst of 6 towards the agressor.
On hit: Apply Prickly. Increase enemy's Prickly level if they already have it, up to level 5.
Prickly duration is additive, being able to stack instead of resetting with each hit.


Reworked Items:
Crystal Bat
Fire1: Throw a ball and charge up your swing for up to 1.25s.
Damage scales with how long you've charged, up to 3x damage at full charge.
Swinging into the ball as it falls will break it into multiple piercing shards that apply Brittle with additive duration.
Shard amount increases with charge, from 2 to 6.


Other Changes:
New cherry leaves texture.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/79334c0d2a57e92122451e8ec617d816c6ba98ff.jpg
Fixed the save indicator freezing while paused, and it no longer appears in camera mode, for reasons you can see above.
Bestiary uses icons instead of text to show stats.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/bc393726690418026f8944a90ed1fce3465b85aa.jpg
Removed the "Leviathan's Body" bestiary entry.
Fixed Gargoyles only being able to hit the player once bruh.
Increased the absolute enemy limit to 40, but the old limit of 20 still applies to spawn waves and hallucinations.
Changed the recipes for Deflect, Ice Barrier, Mirror and Chaos Pistol.
Added conditions to Void, Ice Barrier and Refresh so they can't waste a spell cooldown in situations where they wouldn't do anything.
Removed hidden status effects, such as the ones used by passive items, from the Genesis Crown menu.

notes.title: Update 21, How do they work?
notes.content:
New enemy:
Detractor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/74ef4562b8db74ab03af1079749214b4e0d3248b.png
Spawns on the Floating Pyramids.
Its mobile base attempts to maintain a preferred distance away from its target.
Once at its desired range, the plane takes flight and attacks firing 3 bursts of 2 magnetorbs.
Orbs flank the target, and then magnetize towards eachother.


New items:
Magnetorb
Dropped by Detractors.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/e0e1ce81277e377657198c179cbebdcd37d12ba4.png
Fire1: Throw magnetic orbs that bounce off walls and enemies, dealing low damage.
After 10 seconds, orbs grow and quickly return to you, dealing high damage to enemies along the way.
Fire2: Return all orbs.

Recall
Recipe: Magnetorb + Homing Core + Magnetorb.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/8128c3b1a7b7fd318fa0554bd032fbc4145c07a2.png
Spell cooldown: 2.
All allied projectiles redirect towards you and increase their damage by 20%.

Rebound
Recipe: Deflect + Recall.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/dfac50857bb4a4cacfa6c27b9f824dd4a05131d7.png
Spell cooldown: 8.
All enemy projectiles in a large radius around you become yours; redirect towards their previous owners, and increase their damage by 150%.

Pole Stars
Recipe: Magnetorb + Pet Stars + Magnetorb.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/38c40026f8a34efe65731f7cc740294a372ee972.png
Fire1: Mark an enemy as the north star’s target.
South star constantly spins firing 5 orbs in different directions.
Orbs get pulled towards the north star.

Mag-Rang
Recipe: Bonerang + Magnetorb + Magnetorb.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/4a07ddcc4feca4ff34977edc0c45f96df46047ae.png
Fire1: Throw a boomerang which returns after hitting an enemy.
While returning, the boomerang grows larger and deals double damage.
You can only attack again after the boomerang returns.

Smart Watch
Recipe: Homing Core + Revelation Gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/fddc271c3cc9d14544d1a3f326b5e6f4427ad53f.png
Every 4 seconds, all allied projectiles redirect towards the nearest enemy.


Reworked Items:
Homing Core
Consumable.
All allied projectiles redirect towards the nearest enemy.
"Alien technology capable of moving towards nearby targets."


Other Changes:
Added reflections, with a new video setting to control how frequently they update or disable them entirely.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/274cde3121f02d36c7f51e7c7481fae1ac1c5af6.png
Added visual indicators to (most) passive items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/a1b9586af6154655f0670b0c021fc20791de73b7.gif
Greatly improved the performance of how status effect visuals are handled.
Genesis' second phase Pet Star attack was replaced by a new one using Pole Stars.
Magnetic Jugglers are crafted using 2 Magnetorbs instead of Homing Cores.
Destructable boss spawners can now be targeted by weapons such as the pet rock.
Fixed certain passive effects randomly deactivating.

notes.title: Update 20, Blades Above
notes.content:
New enemy:
Spectre
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3dfbdf0360c2335e132266531314e4eaf2a1c0b5.png
Spawns on the Meteorites.
Floats far from the ground, slowly moving towards the player.
Occasionally fires spectral swords towards the player.


New items:
Spectral Swords
Dropped by Spectres.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/68c8ded2127357168fc388c84629d4a1758df44b.png
Spell cooldown: 5s.
Toss 5 swords upwards, they then retarget towards where you are facing before firing forward.
Upon hitting terrain, the swords stick to it, damaging enemies that contact them.

Blade Bloom
Recipe: Spin Plant + Spectral Swords.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/bd605ee42e5d4962c39cc6294f451b8a49d59082.png
Fire1 Create up to 5 spinning blades that float in front of you before flying off. Release to fire all at once.
Blades float steadily, travel faster, and their velocity while floating does not carry over once fired.

Sky Sword
Recipe: Umbrella + Spectral Swords.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/8cf4dcd68a7354438238f705243cf4e0c1ad9eb2.png
Fire1 Summon a line of 8 giant swords that fall in front of you, sticking to the ground.

Meteorite
Recipe: Airstrike Call + Body Shard + Body Shard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/8ee83fd4139720ef02f0eafc7513201076fa18a1.png
Spell cooldown: 16s.
Summons a massive meteorite which falls in front of you.
Enemies hit by the meteorite receive Earthbound, suffering increased gravity.
Upon hitting the ground, the meteorite causes a huge shockwave that covers the area in flames which apply Meteor Burn.

Abyss
Recipe: Void + Ink Shooter + Soul Shard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/348b8e0142c9f59ab1c9b3a6ced643bf045ab23b.png
Spell cooldown: 10s.
Summon tentacles on the ground beneath up to 4 nearby enemies.
Tentacles grab enemies, dealing damage, applying Ink and holding them in place.

Harpoon Layer
Recipe: Mine Layer + Harpoon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/86aea4ba6a9074fea52e3c4ff7d519f4b0eb1765.png
Fire1 Fire a harpoon mine that travels in an arc, arming itself on impact or after one second.
Upon detonation, these mines fire a harpoon towards the nearest enemy, damaging and pulling them for 5 seconds.

Black Blade
Recipe: Knight + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/2b6dd57e9fef16aaf7d71e7d3d3b95130e7b684d.png
Fire1 Swing the sword, firing a piercing, medium-ranged slash.
Fire2 Hold to block with the sword for up to 4 seconds, becoming invincible, gaining Speed and being able to fly.
Passing through enemies while blocking summons a hovering blade over them. Once you stop blocking, all blades fall.

Shoe Blade
Recipe: Talon Sandals + Sky Orb + Katana.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/a3baa7bcd80f72d66cb2fa2b66e5c50e5742a5e6.png
Passive.
While swapping weapons, perform a powerful kick that pushes you forward.


Other changes:
Added a save indicator animation to the bottom right corner of the screen.
Eternal items can count as multiple copies for recipes that require them.
Gargoyles and Harpies now ragdoll.
Fixed inventory sorting performance issues.
Fixed the Bait inventory's slider not being able to be dragged.
Fixed certain objects not teleporting with the player.
Fixed Sticky-Bomb Ballista projectiles not detonating if the target they were attached to got destroyed, and improved its weakspot hit detection.

notes.title: Update 19, Sky Temple
notes.content:
New area:
Sky Temple
Unlocked by defeating Armageddon with Memory and Furnace.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3834219e5c8de22b7948c00c98bbe5bf99ec81b9.png
The path to the temple is a difficult platforming section, making use of the new Stone Feather and Talon Sandals items.
The new Retry item and spawn points along the temple's path make it quick to keep repeating platforming challenges, while also respawning the enemies whose drops are needed to complete them.
Other mobility items are not deactivated during the platforming, so beating it in other ways is also possible.
The first character to complete the path and reach the temple receives the Sky Orb item, required for all crafting recipies that use Stone Feathers and Talon Sandals.


New enemies:
Gargoyle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/4d67b7977aad61a2f07cce3a5c999a9d173c7d9c.png
Spawns on the Sky Temple.
Alternates between dashing towards you on air and chasing on land, dealing contact damage.

Harpy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/8587fa9344d780b36db122b6462e532e93d75e24.png
Spawns on the Sky Temple.
A highly mobile mini boss, attacks by diving with its talons and firing high-knockback gusts of wind.


New status effect:
Sky Blessing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/34bf78f521058aad28f446dd47cc85a08e16fc5f.png
Move 20% faster and deal 10% more damage.


New items:
Sky Orb
Granted to the first character in a run to reach the Sky Temple.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/7af87ce0830a37e3d20ebecc5ec23a187cb5baf9.png
Eternal, does not get consumed when crafting.
Passive.
Receive Sky Blessing while not touching the ground or swimming.
Required for all recipies that utilize Stone Feathers and Talon Sandals.

Retry
Obtained by touching Sky Temple spawn points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/2383762fd7d407b9fe11289042b1727202db9196.png
Consumable.
Teleport to the last visited spawn point.

Stone Feather
Dropped by Gargoyle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/64d1fd5d147d723f85c2ac4e3a2c5a0c233da098.png
Consumable.
If used on the ground, dash upwards.
If used on the air, do a shorter dash in the direction you’re facing.

Talon Sandals
Dropped by Harpy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/a31abd1e3f0c35b92dd20ca004e292eb3e008409.png
Passive.
While falling near a wall, fall slower and gain Speed.

Anti-Gravity Sandals
Recipe: Sky Orb + Talon Sandals + Barrier.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/9fd3ce3a3f1ab5ffb87f7be64886321a9c1777c0.png
Spell Cooldown: 6.
Project a long barrier in front of you.
Passive: You can fly and gain Speed while near walls or barriers.


Reworked Items:
Bouncy Cannon
Renamed to Carpet Cannon.
Added Scatter Barrel to its recipe.
New model and icon.
Now fires 3 bouncy cannonballs per shot.

Tome Of Thunder
Passive. Use this item to toggle it on or off.
All hits deal half damage, with the other half becoming a lightning bolt that repeatedly bounces between nearby enemies, losing 20% damage per bounce, or 10% if the path between its targets was filled with water.
Lightning disappears once it has no target or its damage falls under 10.

Sand
Consumable.
Throw 10 short-range sand clumps.
"Shinier than usual."

Gunpowder
Consumable.
Throw 10 short-range gunpowder clumps that detonate on impact.
"Can easily cause small explosions."

Other Changes:
Rewrote the entire item bind system. Keybinds are now directly connected to their items instead of inventory slots, meaning that all items of the same type share their keybinds. This is specially noticeable in the case of consumables, as binds will be remembered even if you run out of them.
New toolbar that shows all bound items in your inventory.
New "Camera Mode" button on the pause menu, allowing you to move and look around with a separate camera while the game stays paused, with a variety of settings for taking cool screenshots.
New visual effect when swapping weapons, where the previously equipped weapon stands still and fades away instead of disappearing instantly.
Renamed Mind Aura to Neural Aura.
Tome of Vampirism is crafted using a Scarlet Ore instead of Body Shard.
Twin Arrows are crafted using Spider Arms instead of Remote.
Fixed the Longbow draw animation not perfectly aligning with how charged it actually is.
Added particles to railgun hits.
Using a guardian command without a guardian will automatically summon it if possible.
Boss drops spawn above the player if their inventory is full.
Wasteland Ring is now unlocked by defeating Armageddon with Memory and Rhythm.
Fixed being able to use any guardian commands regardless of its requirements.
Fixed footstep sounds and particles not playing while sprinting.
Various improvements to how damage numbers work, fixing some size and flickering problems.
Updated the music system so that songs can have different crossfade speeds.
Improved the walk animation transitions.
The Time Anomaly mini bosses use the smaller secondary health bars.

notes.title: Update 18, Explosive Arsenal
notes.content:
New items:
Barrage Launcher
Recipe: Missile Launcher + Fish Egg.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/9d6eb7ba84efc87f2bb115f3172567c7fa1604fa.png
Fire1: Hold to place up to 4 targets on enemies. Release to fire a barrage of missiles that chase their targets.

Swarm Launcher
Recipe: Barrage Launcher + Homing Core + Homing Core.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/48f57a813e1405e69fcfbdfece78cf2ad20eb594.png
Fire1: Hold to place up to 6 targets on enemies. Release to fire a swarm of missiles that chase their targets, with 2 missiles per target.
If a missile loses its target, it will home in towards the nearest enemy.

Pocket Pistol
Recipe: Golden Pistol + Barrage Launcher.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/89ab2464af7b2f3d6624574edc8a40b7d74b51e5.png
Spell cooldown: 3s.
Fire a quick burst of 6 precise shots.
Each enemy marked on your HUD by another item will be targeted by one of the shots, auto-aiming towards them and dealing double damage.

Mine Layer
Recipe: Rocket Launcher + Sea Mines.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/91bea4c7eeba317e96fed4922a6e7ce2cf40560d.png
Fire1: Fire a mine that travels in an arc, arming itself on impact or after one second.
Armed mines detonate when an enemy approaches.

Mine Flyer
Recipe: Mine Layer + Cannon Boots + Mind Shard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/ba550355d649ac62cae7d927fc718051829680de.png
Fire1: Fire a bouncy mine that arms quickly and can be detonated on contact with you, dealing no self-damage but high knockback.
Fire2:  Fire a smart mine that travels further and slowly chases its nearest enemy while armed.


Other Changes:
New Crosshair setting, with 3 options: Star, Circle and Dot.
Added dry grass to the desert.
Added god rays to certain weapons with emissive materials.
Added a Mine Layer to the Mine Plant's recipe and its mines now stop for a split second before detonating.
Sea Mines no longer deals self damage.
Directed Knives grant Speed and Blood Knives grant Regeneration when you walk on them.
Fast Rail can get more than one "Combo" by piercing multiple enemies.
The Claw can be equipped with over 50% risk (previously 80%), and grants Immovable.
Having the Immovable effect cancels Earthbound's pull.
The Drone Meteorite's core falls straight down when it ragdolls, making the spawn point of its Guilt Mode phase more predictable and consistent.
One of the Dual Rays only fires the electric fence attack and the other only fires the bouncing lasers.
Updated Apocalypse's bestiary and health bar icons.
Fixed guardian command uses not being saved on the Arsenal.
Fixed the Hydra Pike missing its crafting recipe.
Fixed the Horn missing its use animation.
Fixed Warp Stone map player and bench icons not being aligned properly depending on your screen size.

notes.title: Update 17, Slam & Stab
notes.content:
New enemies:
Bumper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/37cfb04f547f219d9912271b06720a239bc7eb35.png
Spawns on the Volcano Surface during Hammer runs.
Static enemy that bumps the ground creating shockwaves while the player is nearby.

Piercer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/81b5efb5153d893ff2480b01e06ac1447515f0c4.png
Spawns on the Ocean during Pike runs.
Static enemy that stabs the air firing compressed bubbles while the player is above it.


New items:
Hammer
Dropped by the Bumper.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/25a95955c2b0cb51de0debe4fc1b2d2bd3dd4974.png
Fire1: Begin charging up to slam the ground, causing a shockwave and bouncing up.
Shockwave size and bounce height scale with how long it took to hit the ground, doubling after a full second.

Hydro-Hammer
Recipe: Hammer + Isopod Shell + Isopod Shell.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/199383840b9276b81930ffe8253f3a3e4c15c45b.png
Fire1: Begin charging up to slam the ground, causing a shockwave, bouncing up and firing 6 explosive shells that fall towards nearby enemies.
Shockwave size and bounce height scale with how long it took to hit the ground, doubling after 1.4 seconds.
Can slam underwater when fully charged.
If the slam was fully charged, fires homing bubbles instead of shells.

Techno-Hammer
Recipe: Hydro-Hammer + Explosive Blaster + Explosive Blaster.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/216878cdf6b56faa6dbea721ab82ad8e6296c8b5.png
Fire1 Begin charging up to slam the ground, causing a shockwave, bouncing up and creating 4 orbs that fire explosive lasers towards nearby enemies.
Shockwave size and bounce height scale with how long it took to hit the ground, doubling after 1.4 seconds.
Can slam underwater when fully charged.
If the slam was fully charged, greatly increases the range of the explosive lasers.

Maul
Recipe: Hammer + Spider Arms.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/8739cf51dc7dea169468ba57a4b79d26fc1379d4.png
Fire1: Begin charging up to slam the ground, causing a shockwave and bouncing up.
Shockwave size and bounce height scale with how long it took to hit the ground, doubling after 1.4 seconds.
Turn the hammer between attacks, alternating between bouncing higher and a stronger shockwave.

Frostburn Hammer
Recipe: Maul + Ice + Pocket Star.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3fe027f9729ae581679a1d45932cd765f8448205.png
Fire1: Begin charging up to slam the ground, causing a shockwave and bouncing up.
Shockwave size and bounce height scale with how long it took to hit the ground, doubling after a full second.
Can slam underwater when fully charged.
Turn the hammer between attacks, alternating between applying Frostbite and Burning.

Pike
Dropped by the Piercer.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/2efd1530fa6627c65e52bf798fcf5c8f203674e2.png
Fire1: Charge up for 0.6s and thrust forward, firing a compressed air projectile.
Projectile speed scales with charge and, if fully charged, knocks you backwards upon hitting terrain.

Northern Pike
Recipe: Pike + Fish Egg + Water Gun.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/1b4460706c121918bd547b1240f03d66eb7e605c.png
Fire1: Charge up for 0.6s and thrust forward, firing a compressed air projectile.
Projectile speed scales with charge and, if fully charged, knocks you backwards upon hitting terrain.
Upon disappearing, the projectile summons a fish that chases nearby enemies.

Hydra Pike
Recipe: Northern Pike + Soul Shard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/7fe88dcdff172fe44b8de86f33aca2b06c0691d9.png
Fire1: Charge up for 0.6s and thrust forward, firing two compressed air projectiles.
Projectile speed scales with charge and, if fully charged, they knock you backwards upon hitting terrain.
Upon disappearing, each projectile summons a head that chases nearby enemies.
If the attack was fully charged, both heads split into 2 smaller ones shortly after.

Pull Pike
Recipe: Pike + Void + Spider Bite.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/59efc52edc60fb6fa09196d7bc87713a24e53c12.png
Fire1: Charge up for 0.8s and thrust forward, firing a compressed air projectile that implodes repeatedly, pulling nearby enemies.
Projectile speed scales with charge and, if fully charged, pulls you towards it upon disappearing.

Elephant Goad
Recipe: Pike + Harpoon + Harpoon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/28b7db6151d7af1ba436262e8e2696f0af6719d3.png
Fire1: Charge up for 1s and thrust forward, firing a compressed air projectile.
Projectile speed scales with charge and, if fully charged, grabs enemies it hits, dragging them along until disappearing.


New Commands:
Slam
Enabled by having: Maul, Techno-Hammer, The Builder.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3707fdff1870afe9015c70c1e7307d483e68bc0c.png
Cooldown: 5.
Command your guardian to dash towards its target or the ground, creating a powerful shockwave on impact.

Stab
Enabled by having: Pike, Northern Pike, Pull Pike.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/45df7fc8af7537eb0350dd030a9d800a6d1638ad.png
Cooldown: 2.
Command your guardian to stab forward, firing a compressed air projectile.


Other Changes:
Guardians also refill their health when you rest.
The Battle Axe is now crafted using a Hammer or Pike instead of Longsword.
The Builder is now crafted using a Maul instead of Spider Gauntlets, and its primary attack works like other hammers.
The Carmine Polearm is now crafted using a Pike instead of 3 Sticks and its primary attack works like other pikes. Instead of healing on hit, fully charged attacks make you take 50 "ghost damage", activating positive effects that require taking damage without any downsides.
Deflect spell deals double the taken damage.
Added a particle and sound effect that indicates when chargeable weapons are fully charged.
Added destruction particles to the projectiles from several items.
Certain particles no longer disappear as soon as their object gets destroyed, this is specially noticeable in projectiles such as the Fireball.
New model for the shell rocket projectiles.
The Anomaly Hunter no longer has separate hurtboxes for each limb because that caused it to take way more damage from certain piercing weapons.
Genesis' Icicle attack was replaced by a new one using the Frostburn Hammer. Also added an attack using the Pull Pike that replaces it during Pike runs.
The day/night cycle smoothly moves towards the countdown's time, no longer snapping when the countdown instantly changes such as when a boss is defeated.

notes.title: Update 16, Assembly
notes.content:
New Arena:
Revelation Assembly
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3f1ccc1ae5abd4ed550a7f265a5b8030c4a63f9d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/39b6fbfd8c7fa4d33a0ea5d3b55969dec48a004c.gif
A room found in the Laboratory that can only be accessed once you've gotten what was previously the "Armageddon Wings" unlock.
Fight through multiple hand-crafted waves of late-game and unlockable enemies.

New items:
Revelation Core
Dropped by the Revelation Assembly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/24fc9a47e318235c6caf2e75a2e2c79ede471bd3.png
Use to split into multiple gears that can be used to craft powerful equipment.
"Why design these machines to assist you? Although I do admire the spectacle, nothing stops you from doing your job without them."

Revelation Gear
Gain 4 by using the Revelation Core.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/46dcaae1b35882db08943ba55b2374d112806c7e.png
"Light, matter and motion. All as one."

Tome Of Revelation
Recipe: Green Page + Revelation Gear + Revelation Gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/9e3eeb0348d5779e37aa1440050715180331f3dc.png
Passive. Use this item to toggle it on or off.
Summons a Revling that fights for you, targeting nearby enemies and alternating between firing homing bombs and performing a high-damage dash.
While you’re under half max-hp or after performing a Perfect Graze, the Revling enrages, improving the homing capabilities of the bombs and firing a laser beam before dashing.

True Clockwork
Recipe: Scarlet Ore + The Clockwork + Voltaic Ore + Revelation Gear + Revelation Gear + Revelation Gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/0eeb8f0a437f9d84f306a259ed104c5975efd74b.png
Fire1: Hold to charge up, release to teleport in the direction you're facing, creating an afterimage that damages enemies along the way applying Out Of Time and creating gears for each hit, up to 5. Teleport distance scales with charge.
Gain Geared for each gear.
The following attacks utilize your gears, with X being the number of gears used. Each gear can be used 3 times before disappearing.
Fire2: Fire 2*X homing bubbles which create ice water that applies Frostbite.
Fire3: Throw X slashing projectiles which apply Bleeding.
Fire4: Place a plasma bomb that shocks 10*X times, stunning enemies in a large radius.

Pacemaker
Recipe: Heal + Revelation Gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/90f871feb58f7a318b389ef67af954f364246a97.png
Passive.
Every 4 seconds, heal 20hp.

Frozen Watch
Recipe: Ice + Revelation Gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/d6ddfd5cbb8f9aae3a8e36d9a7a01272f8cfca49.png
Passive.
Every 4 seconds, gain Brain Freeze.


New Status Effect:
Geared
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/9eae7a7ba93bfb2d14881d9b9e3fc6b60d58f40a.png
Take 10% less damage and move 20% faster.

Out Of Time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/df2453cba8c2cd9168d20f262af92d6d6f8b7f40.png
Take 2.5% of your max health as damage 2 times per second.


Other changes:
New song for the 3 arenas.
Added 2 Revelation Gears to the Armageddon Wings' crafting recipe.
Buffed all Armageddon Wings attacks.
Fixed the Crystal icon not being blue.
Items can have custom icon sizes. This is mostly used by pixel art ones to make sure there are no stretched pixels.
The Underground Ruin and Wasteland Ring crystals no longer respawn after defeating them.
Apocalypse now holds a True Clockwork.
Harpoon Plant's detach range is now a cylinder instead of cone, making it easier to escape from far away.
Fixed a bug that caused certain attacks to be blocked by water.
Fixed the inventory clearing the item info if you deselect an item while still hovering over it.
Fixed blurry edges on some particle effects.
Added a 3rd coil to the Teslas weapon, it can be thrown by pressing Fire3.

notes.title: Update 15, Blending Together
notes.content:
New Items:
Timeless Blades
Recipe: Clock Pointers/Directed Knives + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/1a7b509a5dbcfe8acc2a5ddaebb4e326bc6d6992.png
Fire1: Throw a giant spear that creates static knives as it travels.
After hitting any enemy or surface, the spear teleports backwards, retargets towards its nearest enemy and fires itself again. This can repeat up to 4 times.
Once the spear disappears, all knives are thrown towards their nearest enemies.
Wand
Recipe: Minigun/Railgun + Past.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/b598f78f38048422ca5597acadf58e3e8346da7a.png
Fire1: Rapidly fire magic orbs which speed up spell cooldowns by 0.05s on hit.
Fire2: Fire a piercing laser which speeds up spell cooldowns by 1s per enemy hit.
Flail
Recipe: Boomerang/Yoyo + Sword.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/adecc2cc9d873c4c602467857197fa105f6cb2a8.png
A spike ball freely swings connected to the flail by a chain, damaging all enemies it touches.
Fire1: Swing the flail, throwing the ball forward then pulling it back.
Electri-Sentry
Recipe: Sandstone Sentry + Voltaic Ore.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/9fb01731f690313b0200bd334c6d2e5774254037.png
Fire1: Place a sentry which automatically targets nearby enemies, firing short-range electricity currents that cannot miss.
Makes other sentries fire an electricity ring every second, dealing 10 damage to all nearby enemies.

World Changes:
Terrain is now smooth shaded.
Terrain materials smoothly transition between areas.
Put the sea grass material on the oasis.
Some visual improvements to the ocean current, specially on the main menu.
Added a safe guard so you can't get softlocked on the Underground Ruin elevator.

Item Changes:
Warp Stone map now uses a separate camera, so it renders the world in real time (at a 5th of the game's frame rate for performance) and I don't have to bother remaking a bunch of images every time an update changes the world.
Added a player indicator to the Warp Stone map.
Crouching after all carts have left the portal will cause the Train to stop and explode.
Spider Sentry's legs now attempt to find targets within 100 meters to walk towards if the sentry using them isn't targeting anything and has a lower sight range than that.
Increased Fireball's explosion radius. You no longer get damaged by the explosion and only receive burning for 2 seconds if caught in it.
Anchor is crafted using a Flail instead of a Harpoon.
All of the knives, spears and boomerangs disappear from your hand during their throwing animation.

Enemy Changes:
Coda Drones turn white when ragdolling.
Poison Flowers, Shellfish and Spiders lose certain parts when ragdolling, as those represent the items they drop.
Assalt/Sniper Sentinels have a shorter target distance, no longer shooting at you from anywhere.

notes.title: Update 14, Crystal Rain
notes.content:
New Items:
Tome Of Motion
Recipe: Blue Page + Blue Page + Kinetic Shank + Yellow Page + Yellow Page.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/826e4133861f6afd31d57f24122592e852ef90d8.png
Passive. Use this item to toggle it on or off.
Movement speed ramps up as you move, from 20% to 300% over the course of 6 seconds, resetting to 20% while standing still.
Lose some speed when you press one of the four movement keys.
Creates a damaging radius around you, its size and damage scale with your velocity, up to 10x.
Upon hitting an enemy, the radius disappears for 2 seconds.

DNAilgun
Recipe: Nailgun + Body Shard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/8570f66272c04088fc3f77b5ff477afc3d57ab96.png
Fire1: Rapidly fires bursts of two nails which move in a helix pattern.
Nails damage enemies and heal allies.
On hit: Certain enemy types become friendly. This effect’s duration is additive, being able to stack instead of resetting with each hit.
Friendly enemies lose 5% of their health per second.

New Status Effect:
Thunderstruck
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/fd321dabe9fad2e8375aad0c33fc25d2418a0ba1.png
Lose your velocity 10 times per second.

Other Changes
Crystal Trench area now opens by crystals growing and destroying the platform.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/72eaf26a5a6a669f2d812b1eb91dc830a9ac568d.gif
Added a small decoration to the bench on top of a tree to the north of the Start Shrine, and moved it to be between the Rain Fountain and Cherry Blossom.
Updated the Warp Stone map to reflect the changes above.
Rain Fountain now has a flower which blooms over the course of a run, fully opening once the countdown reaches 12 hours to reveal a crystal that can be destroyed to start the rain.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/fad829b50e9548dda3e035ecb42a77e9a9a69a86.gif
Updated the rain bestiary spawner and achievement icons to reflect the change above.
Friendly enemies have a clock icon showing their health, similar to the one that shows sentry durations.
Friendly enemies don't count to the "weight" used by the spawn wave system.
Lightning Staff, Surge and the Thunder Bird enemy apply the new Thunderstruck effect, for 0.5, 2 and 1 seconds respectively.
Changed the Tome of Vampirism visual effect to have transparent lines moving up, similar to the Pyramid elevators.
Barrier and Mirror are now spells instead of weapons.

notes.title: Update 13, Command
notes.content:
Using the Stone Guardian item now opens a new "Command Inventory" screen in which you can summon or dismiss it. Having certain items on your inventory allows you to command it to perform specific actions.
New Item:
Starless Guardian
Recipe: Stone Guardian + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/6c8291d383e5ef3d51fe8f68850036de9672c94b.png
Opens the Command Inventory; letting you summon, dismiss and command a starless guardian that follows you and attacks nearby enemies.
Guardian has 400hp and can be targeted and attacked by enemies; upon dying there's a 20 second cooldown before you can summon another one.
You can only have one guardian at any moment. Dismissing it will start a cooldown based on how full its health was.
Attacks with a wide 3 hit combo, moves faster and targets enemies further away compared to the Stone Guardian.


New Commands:
Swap
Enabled by having: Teleporter, Warp Stone.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/6e9bf69a3bc8746b7aed92965a7eea4702cc3b6a.png
Cooldown: 4.
Swap positions with your guardian.


Scatter
Enabled by having: Scatter Barrel, Lead Star.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/76a6908560c8c0bcb59e2fc054e3b85b1caba347.png
Cooldown: 3.
Commands your guardian to fire 3 homing projectiles.


Leech
Enabled by having: Scythe, Reaper.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/c6ad14b93ea5fd45bce4e054d3ba09cc6b844083.png
Cooldown: 6.
Commands your guardian to drain health from nearby enemies, applying Bleeding and healing it for each enemy hit.


Heal
Enabled by having: Regeneration Potion, Heal, Regen Edge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/b56a08dcccc0afb72438847e2d6c9d5d0f43a7dc.png
Cooldown: 4.
Commands your guardian to heal itself by 100hp.


Detonate
Enabled by having: Rocket Launcher, Cannon, Gunpowder.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/4ad3543655b6fb7c10ebf2e6955815712814f0a0.png
Cooldown: 4.
Commands your guardian to detonate, causing a large explosion but taking 50 damage.


Contaminate
Enabled by having: Poisonthrower, Poison Jar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/a7375061edcb370b9b1042b1c26687f41188f7ce.png
Cooldown: 2.5.
Apply Poison to your guardian, gain Poisonous.


Turret
Enabled by having: Sandstone Sentry, Floaty Sentry, Spider Sentry, Builder.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/0782301f410dff3a55abb7f71d1e38b88598597d.png
Cooldown: 3.
Grant your guardian a turret for 5 seconds, making it take half damage while standing still shooting nearby enemies.
Works with buffs from other placed sentries.


Flood
Enabled by having: Water Gun, Water Ball, Ice Wings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/165036ffa36257c516063a23ba1c0c49e4de1176.png
Cooldown: 2.
Command your guardian to rush forward leaving a trail of water.


Other changes:
Game over screen shows which characters won and which lost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/16f1ae409e0c1d00cf26f434081fda2b242f4971.png
The player becomes invincible during end boss death animations.
If an entity with Frostbite receives Burn, or vice versa, it will cleanse both effects taking 200 damage per level and get wet for 5 seconds.
Spider Bite now fires a short range web projectile, instead of acting like a sword.
Nerfed Blast Shooter's damage and range.

notes.title: Update 12, Prey.
notes.content:
New Boss:
Anomaly Hunter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/949119895e2288246cdac538a6e9bc4c2ea32335.png
With prey mode enabled, appears once the countdown reaches 18, 12 and 6 hours remaining.
Each encounter acts as a different phase, gaining new moves for each one.
Each attack makes it move in different ways; combines them to act unpredictably while chasing you regardless of where in the map you are.
New theme for its battle.

New run setting:
Prey mode:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/d5dc21fdcd54b9e3a347b1b0f2681aeba1c25ee6.png
Unlocked by obtaining 2 unlocks which require winning with multiple characters in the same run.
Every 6 hours, the Anomaly Hunter will challenge you.
Defeating it grants you Aether, used to craft powerful upgrades.

New items, with these there are now over 300!:
Aether
Dropped by the Anomaly Hunter.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/423e03abec2b67870f05a0ae0df936604befa4a5.png
"Latent matter, or the lack of it. Exists only to be molded by the Anomaly."

Hunter's Launcher
Recipe: Rocket Launcher + Aether + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/7b3d13286f138d283c0bc7b6b88238ff9ab33067.png
Fire1: Fire a rocket that travels towards where you are looking and generates clouds which constantly damage anything touching them.
Fires twice as fast while in the air.
Explosions can’t damage you and knock you backwards at high speeds.
Rockets don’t follow your aim while holding fire2.

Final Spark
Recipe: Spark + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/01645bb90c79c224c53cb3292775d7bf04f46ead.png
Spell cooldown: 12.
Fire a black hole which pulls in enemies then generates a large laser beam.

Aether Arrow
Recipe: Wood Arrow + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/42b7e2c0b300b099dcad96582b0b73129f9e1174.png
Can only be equipped with the Longbow.
All other arrows in your inventory get shot alongside it.

Dim Gun
Recipe: Flare Gun + Aether.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/9cb6d4cfe2f6991763b01b86792719ee9f18bf7b.png
Fire1 Fire a dim flare which explodes on impact and applies Dark Flames.
Enemies take an extra 100 damage for each unique negative status effect + 25 per effect level.

Other changes:
New Sub Scanner model and behavior.
Added bubble particles coming out of the Submarine's proppeler
Fixed the Submarine's missile speed being framerate dependent.
Updated stick's description to mention the faster switch speed.
Arsenal slots update when you open it.
Death animation that shows you losing a live no longer plays in the tutorial.
Improved water to avoid causing visible seams in spheres.
Volatile effect's explosion is larger if the enemy is also wet.
Fixed Spark dealing yellow damage.
Explosive Arrow can knock you back.
Changed Fireball's crafting recipe to Pocket Star + Gunpowder. The Cannon was needed for way too many items, this cuts its recipes in half.
Spark is crafted using a Pocket Star instead of Fireball, so it can still be obtained at any time.

notes.title: Update 11, Bat Blast Blossom
notes.content:
New items:
Stasis Bat
Recipe: Bat + Null Bombs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/f7ba4f2d8269edc695653d7b3e6e16c4c3f476c0.png
Weapon.
Fire1: throw 3 balls and charge up your swing for up to 0.8s.
Damage scales with how long you've charged, up to 3x damage at full charge.
Swinging into a ball as it falls will add the swing's damage to it and cause it to stop mid-air.
Stopped balls will accumulate the velocity from each swing that hits it.
Hitting a ball 3 times will cause it to fly off and create a large implosion on impact.
Fire2: Fire off all stopped balls.

Bowling Set
Recipe: Bat + Mind Shard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/f70977a0c03f611544238c36ea97c7bd7958fd15.png
Weapon.
Fire1: throw 6 floating pins and start charging up for up to 1.5s.
Release to throw a ball, its damage and speed scale with how long you've charged, up to 5x at full charge.
Ball can pierce enemies, bounce off walls and roll on the ground.
Pins hit with sufficient force add 100 damage to the ball.

Blaster Gatler
Recipe: Snowball Gatler + Explosive Blaster.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3728cef395956eb64545c47ca7344a6200b1994b.png
Weapon.

Starts firing 6x slower, taking 15 shots to spin up to full speed.
Spins back down in 1 second without firing.
You move slower while firing.

Blast Shooter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/606fcaf5b7d48148b34f11cd826b901e50c8fb1e.png
Weapon.

Fire2: Reload all ammo at once.
Needs to be reloaded every 6 shots.
Laser damage, range and explosion radius are multiplied by the number of shots remaining.

Thorn Staff
Recipe: Lightning Staff + Needler.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/f2c94688d2a3d6dc17ad46f5211959f611cc2b0d.png
Weapon.
Fire1: Quickly cast thorns on the ground under where you’re looking at. After some time they grow into giant spikes which apply Splinter to enemies that touch them.

Blossom
Recipe: Spin Plant + Starfish.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3333b96891e190d3904d5c73b12d7fa7895e2206.png
Spell cooldown: 3.
Summon 8 orbiting flowers which damage enemies on impact.
The flowers shoot off away from you after 5 seconds.

Other changes:
Apocalypse has muscles.
Improved Apocalypse's final phase transition.
Challenge order window now shows the bosses that will be fought.
Ice wings fires 2 more projectiles for obvious reasons.
Tome of Thunder is now crafted using Voltaic Ore instead of Sarcophagunner's Item Bag

notes.title: Update 10, Re-Revelation
notes.content:
The demo has also received a new version, so all changes from this update are applied to it.
Changes:

2 new Revelation attacks.
New visual effect which predicts where Revelation's homing bombs will land, only in phase 1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/1568cbefb7d89bb63167fa1b0fad2b154f522426.gif
Fixed part of revelation's wings and crown not changing materials between phases.
Perfect Graze key has been renamed to Dodge. It now causes you to quickly throw yourself in the direction you were moving; similar to the Rush spell. Your graze radius will not follow you during most of the pgraze window, staying behind where you started your dodge. To compensate, increased the dodge cooldown when a pgraze is not performed.
Added a button to the game's official wiki on the main menu.
Multiple items can no longer be bound to the same key.
The respawn screen stars become visible while you're under a 3rd of your max health, getting more opaque the lower you get.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/f1297b089af1ac083b31ee587b9cff67136090e4.png
Fixed Augment losing its experience during the end.
Broken Clock and The Clockwork actually reduce 2 seconds from the countdown when time-skipping.
Enemies can take multiple hits from the Prickly effect when teleporting, based on the teleport distance. This doesn't apply to the player.
Decreased Prickly's damage from 10 to 5, touching a cactus on the desert applies it with level 3.
Decreased Frostbite's damage from 15 to 7.5. Ice wings now applies it with level 2.
Chill Shiv now spends its hits and throws snowballs one at a time. Snowballs apply Frostbite1 and can increase an enemy's Frostbite level up to level 3, without resetting its duration. Also increased it's attack delay from 0.6 to 1 second.
Changed the default bait when first equipping a fishing rod to the golemite item required to craft it or its previous version.
Bobbers create ripples while fishing, with much larger ones right before being pulled.
Fixed a hilarious bug which essentially allowed you to swap the animations of two weapons.

notes.title: Update 9, Inventory Improvements
notes.content:
The game's demo has also gotten a new version, so all of the changes from this update and previous ones have been applied to it.
New items:
Resistance Potion
Recipe: Petal + Shellmet.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/3e5642b9925b86b2143ae2349d305e11562fcf4e.png
Consumable.
Grants Resistance and Immovable when consumed.

Block
Recipe: Resistance Potion + Petal.
Used to craft Deflect instead of Heal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/487f0edd9e8fcb019874705a83731a540c6ba5ae.png
Spell cooldown: 3.
Grants Resistance 3 to all nearby allies for one second.

Purge
Recipe: Heal + Poison Jar + Waterball.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/79a11c424cceac0255d58b10cf05f95c9a7bac62.png
Spell cooldown: 10
Cleanse all negative status effects from everyone.
Enemies take 100 damage per unique cleansed effect + 25 per effect level.
Allies heal 20 hp per unique cleansed effect + 10 per effect level.

Other changes:
Fully revamped the tutorial.
Item categories. There are 6 categories: Unique, Power, Mobility, Survival, Support and Difficult. They serve as a rough guide to the use of an item. Each item can be assigned to multiple categories, with a number from 1 to 5 to show how much it specializes in that category.
Removed the crafting slot. Simply right clicking to select an item will show its recipe list.
You can always bind multiple items of the same type to the same key.
If an item is selected, the inventory's tooltip will default to its name and description whenever it would be empty.
The inventory's item status effect screen will always show the effects for the item shown on the tooltip. Combined with the previous change, it should be way easier to understand than the previous lock method.
Added a button to acess the Arsenal from the Inventory.
The arsenal can place other icons above the crafting recipes for items obtained through other means such as enemy drops or bag rewards.
All text boxes can now automatically decrease their font sizes to fit all their text if needed.
New sprite for setting slider handles.
Moved the language setting to GUI instead of Gameplay.
New Crouch Collect gameplay setting. Off by default. When enabled, you'll only collect items from the ground while holding the crouch key.
Bound Item Sorting setting is now just a toggle, instead of a dropdown with 4 confusing options.
Hallucinations despawn without spawning their enemies if you get near one while a boss is alive or during the countdown ending animation.
Buffed pull speed of all the grappling hooks.
Mech Suit is now crafted with Ankh + Duality Core + Sea Weight. Buffed the stats for all its modules because of this.
You can recraft the Soul, Body and Mind using their shards.
Added sounds to weapon reloads.
New Metal icon and model.
New visuals for the Refresh spell.
All juggler projectiles have a way smaller terrain collider, separate from their damaging hitbox, so hitting enemies near terrain is more reliable.
The Stone Guardian, Thermal Signal, Reaper's skeletons, Mini Factory's drones and Builder's sentries can now receive status effects.
The countdown stops while resting.
Improved the respawn/rest background.
New respawn animation.

notes.title: Update 8, Visual Overhaul
notes.content:
New items:
Refresh
Recipe: Heal + Golden Pistol.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/e83b391affd08441258ab5cfb7fb06deaeb3cb25.png
Spell cooldown: 6
Instantly fill up any resources such as ammo or energy, and refresh cooldowns for abilities such as dashes and charges for your current weapon.

Cactus Bud
Recipe: Starfish + Sand.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/6e81ce1031c1e31e3e8f0d64be991f9c4511b139.png
Fire1: Shoot 3 rings of 8 spines around you.
On hit: Apply "Prickly". Increase enemy's "Prickly" level if they already have it, up to level 3.
"Prickly" duration is additive, being able to stack instead of resetting with each hit.

New status effect:
Prickly
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/f0122cb93c9eda7878c33b5ccdf392987d64c91d.png
Take 10 damage and decrease this effect’s duration by 0.25s for every 5 meters moved.

Other changes:
New skybox.
New Render Scale video setting. Default 0.95, min 0.2, max 1. The scale in which the game is rendered. Lower values may improve performance, but will cause most things to look pixelated.
New Load Distance video setting. Default 1, min 0, max 3. Multiplies the distance at which props such as grass and kelp get rendered. This has a big impact on performance.
Added 2560x1440 option to the resolution setting.
New texture for the underside of cone trees.
New flower vase on top of the starter shrine.
Layered a few extra textures on certain materials, making them look more 3d.
Cloud and Water effects are now pixelated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/4746a62c83f79c9b78c37586b73be3d10fd5cbab.gif
Lighting changes more throrought a run, specially by properly rotating with the sun and moon.
Because of that last change, de-aligned the sun and moon with the exact West/East to make the lighting less flat.
Added cacti all over the desert. Anything that touches them will receive the new "Prickly" effect for 2 seconds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/2a691e27ecdbf1237681e86e89e013f437d1629a.png
Improved kelp.
Added a new sea grass texture around the whale fall area.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/0fe7c3da5754c83eb796c46acad57af9e74a0d1a.png
Improved the Anomaly terrain material. It now covers the ground inside and around anomalous bubbles.
Warp stone's map now also shows the icons for benches you haven't rested at, but darker.
Fixed the order of crafting recipies which you have all materials for. It used to be reversed.
Charged Dagger and Spider Bite now trigger their effects when attacking the ground.
Builder's sentry lasers pierce through terrain and barriers.

notes.title: Update 7, Enemy Revamp
notes.content:
Natural enemy spawn changes:
2d hallucinations of enemies regularly spawn all over the world. Approaching a hallucination will transform it into a real version of that enemy.
In general, hallucinations should give the player more control over enemy encounters, as you can actively seek the enemies you want to fight. It also adds a lot to the ambience, as you can now see the world be populated by enemies even from afar.
The old spawn system is still present, but on a slower cooldown; creating less frequent bursts of action. Smaller areas which do not benefit too well from the hallucinations, such as the starter shrine and volcano underground, now speed up its cooldown.

Enemy changes:
Iron Turret & Steel Turret
Renamed to Assault Sentinel & Sniper Sentinel.
New models.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/5187de09c418025a42b386faf3da4bd6b1648f59.png
Horizontal and Vertical aiming are now separated, with assaults rotating faster horizontally and snipers vertically.

Treader & Neo Treader
New models.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/e033f0ad0ad8fcf38f7279fd99b04a75f21e47a0.png
Can now aim vertically towards you.

Rang Bot & Yoyo Bot
Added ragdoll.
Attacks properly get cancelled upon dying, with the yoyo string snapping just like when you swap away from Yoyo weapons.

Living Breeze
New model & material. This change also affects certain boss attacks which used similar wind effects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/4229844a1ab0e0eed48bef761b22f0dbda943727.gif
Now create an explosion of sand particles upon dying.

Shell, Knight, Bishop and Tank
No longer have ragdolls.
Now create an explosion of anomaly particles upon dying.

Thunder Bird
Added ragdoll.
A ring of electricity particles converge on it before attacking, just like the Lightning Rod's effect.

Sarcophagunner
Checks 5 positions before deciding where it wants to teleport to, to avoid standing on trees or bones.

Defense System
Takes 20% more damage while wet, because why not?

Other changes:
Mortar deals 60% less self-damage, so 50 by default like the other rocket launchers used in its recipe.
Improved visibility of the lines going up from benches.
Added 3 more main elevators up to the pyramids, and they are now cylinders which continuously grant you the floating effect while in them.
New pyramid elevator materials.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203506/d10e31ede465665b1f63dc9b1bd115c7be093414.gif

notes.title: Update 6, Randomizer
notes.content:
New run setting:
Random mode:
Unlocked by unlocking 80% of the Bestiary.
Natural enemy spawns are scrambled, so each area has different creatures each run.
Also affects arenas and golemite huts.
Ocean enemies can swim in the air.

New weapon:
Anchor
Recipe: Sea Weight + Harpoon + Gunpowder.
Fire1: Do one of the three following actions:
While anchor is in hand, hold to charge up and release to throw the anchor. Throw speed scales with charge.
While anchor is flying, transfer its velocity directly downwards. This also happens if the anchor hits an enemy directly.
While anchor is stuck, pull it back over your head. Pull speed scales with distance between you and the anchor.
A rope connects you and the anchor, pulling you towards it.
Once the anchor hits the ground, it’ll get stuck and cause an explosion.
Damage and explosion radius scale with the anchor’s speed, up to 5x.
Move towards the anchor to grab it while it’s stuck.

New enemy:
Coda Drone
Replaces the anomaly bubble ones during the Armageddon fight.
Has 3 different attacks and behaviours, one for each Armageddon phase.

Other changes:
Poison Flowers now ignore their vertical distance to you, and their poison floats underwater.
Tortoises and Knights can now swim, aligning themselves vertically with you while underwater.
While underwater, Ice Crabs move faster and fire extra icicles upwards.
While underwater, Oak Walkers and Charred Oaks create a larger shockwave that travels upwards.
Train carts lose their collision when going near the edges of the map.
Changed the sand texture, mostly just desaturating its colors.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45203506/aad7f96120965d5d5aee5967826f45a5be98ed3a.png
Fixed certain enemies not becoming ice statues when dying with Frostbite.
Fixed the Swarmers spawned by Drone Meteorite ignoring damage.

notes.title: Update 5, Constant Haste
notes.content:
New run settings:
Constant mode:
Unlocked by winning with all characters of a run in less than 40 minutes total.
Countdown naturally decreases at 30x speed.
Defeating enemies does not skip the countdown.
The items Past, Present and Future can only be used in crafting.

Haste mode:
Unlocked by winning with a character that was played for less than 20 minutes in the run.
Countdown decreases at double the rate, both naturally and by defeating enemies.

Other changes:
Redesigned the run start menu, with the settings in the middle of the screen. Extra modes are now always there, with a lock icon if you haven't unlocked them yet. Hovering over the modes makes their descriptions show up on the Boons tab, or how to unlock them if you haven't.
New Guilt and Genesis mode icons.
New sprite for the X button to close the game, it used to be just text.
Remade Frail's icons.
Thermonuclear Wings' fully charged laser beam lasts slightly longer and aims towards where you are looking.
The slow fall effect gained from wings no longer stops the Fall spell from moving you down.
Deflect is now crafted with Heal+Crystal and its effect is properly applied to friendly enemies.
Armageddon's adaptative resistance works with every 2.5% of its max health, instead of the usual 5%.

notes.title: Update 4, More Ambience
notes.content:
Changes:
Went through every single material used in the world (grass, rocks, bricks...) adding bump/normal maps, which change how they react to light making things feel less flat.
Added flying critters which move between certain points of the map, with 9 types of butterflies on the forest, 3 types of flies on the desert, and 9 types of fish in the ocean.
Added ash particles around the player while at the volcano area.
Remodeled the Oasis' waterfall and added splash particle effects. Also moved several palm trees to better surround the Oasis.
Added achievements for defeating Revelation, Armageddon, Genesis and Apocalypse, and for unlocking the Genesis Crown.
Remade Armageddon's health bar icons.
Fixed errors caused by deleting an existing save to start a new one on the same slot.
Fixed the reset buttons on the Controls settings not working.
Fixed the bench near the Library not having a Warp Stone icon.
Fixed some untranslated menu texts.

notes.title: Update 3, Falling Needles
notes.content:
New items:

Fall
Hex
Needle Shooter

Other changes:

Meteor Core applies Earthbound directly to the player instead of its target, so you can't avoid it by making it target something else.
Sunset gives Resistance 3 instead of 2, from 50% to 75% damage reduction.
Guilt Defense System no longer collides with the player on its final phase.

notes.title: Update 2, Lategame Fishing.
notes.content:
New Items:

Abyssal Angler
Flesh Angler
Navy Angler

Other changes:

Snowball Gatler spins up over 15 shots instead of 4 seconds, so fire rate changes affect how quickly you reach max speed.
Double Shotgun and Slayer Shotgun knock you backwards, the closer the target the farther you go.
Fixed being able to open the Bait Inventory while on the normal Inventory, which was really annoying.
Fixed bobbers not leaving the fishing state when they're no longer on water, which meant you could fish on land as long as they hit water once.
That being said, doubled the Waterball's duration, so fishing on it is possible.
Fixed Tome Of Blades' spear not chasing you while it doesn't have a target.
Bishops count as defeated on the bestiary when they die by not having Knights for them to heal.
Several fixes relating to enemy target points, making sure weapons that should target them work correctly.
Went through every single enemy making sure their weakspots and target points are placed correctly.
Updated descriptions for several items to be more in line with other descriptions, such as showing exactly what buttons to press for their attacks.
Updated the Warp Stone's description to explain the map and bench icons, instead of the old functionality where you held it like a weapon. How did I forget to do that in the first place? Why did it take so long for me to notice it? Whatever, it's fixed now.

notes.content:

Fishing Rock

Other changes:

New Backups folder for each save file, in which the last 10 Main saves are kept.
Changes to how saving works to hopefully make it more reliable.
Killing Revelation's rolling gears deals 150 damage to it.
Fixed defeating certain enemies not saving them on the bestiary.
Fixed Scary Shell's visuals persisting between characters.
Fixed being able to damage the Underground Ruin by attacking its door.
Fish Guardians no longer damage themselves and eachother.
